name: Mezcal
description: A Mexican agave spirit, most famously from Oaxaca: the agave piñas are roasted in earthen pits before fermentation and distillation, which gives the smoke mezcal is known for. Espadín is the workhorse agave. A split base with gin or a straight swap for tequila; the Naked & Famous made it a cocktail-bar staple.
